BrochureContent.Content:
Brian Gleeson Property are delighted to present this executive three-bedroom semi-detached residence located within the sought-after Monksfield estate in Abbeyside, Dungarvan, Co. Waterford.

No. 76 Monksfield is an impressive A-rated, energy-efficient home presented in immaculate condition. Combining modern style with comfort, this beautifully maintained property offers a blank canvas for its new owners to make their own.

The property comprises a welcoming entrance hallway with the opportunity to create generous under-stairs storage, along with a spacious front living room featuring a solid fuel stove, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The home also benefits from fully fitted blackout blinds throughout, offering enhanced comfort. 

The heart of the home is the bright and spacious open-plan kitchen and dining area, which flows effortlessly into the sunroom. French doors open onto the rear patio and garden, providing the perfect setting for indoor-outdoor living, entertaining and family life. A practical utility room with outdoor access and guest WC complete the ground floor accommodation.

Upstairs, the property offers three well-proportioned bedrooms (master bedroom en-suite) with fitted wardrobes. A large family bathroom completes the upper level.

Outside, the low-maintenance rear garden has been designed for easy living and features a lovely patio area, perfect for outdoor entertaining and al fresco dining during the warmer months. The garden also offers ample space for a garden shed, making it both practical and functional.
Ideal for commuting, the property is conveniently located near the N25 roadway, offering easy access to Waterford, Cork and Dublin, which is just a two-hour drive away. Additionally, the home is situated closely to a number of primary and secondary schools, award-winning restaurants, and a wide variety of shops and cafés.

Beautifully located with the Waterford Greenway and Clonea beach on your doorstep, No. 76 has being lovingly maintained by its current owner and makes an ideal choice for those seeking a perfect family home, a retirement haven or a weekend pad.

Enjoy the pictorial essay and call Brian Gleeson Property to arrange your private viewing.
